import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.StreamTokenizer;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;

public class newProgram2 {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        StreamTokenizer st = new StreamTokenizer(new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in)));
        st.wordChars('-', '-');
        st.wordChars('0', '9');

        st.nextToken();
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.sval);
        st.nextToken();
        int b = Integer.parseInt(st.sval);

        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st.nextToken();
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.sval);
        }

        if (b < 0) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        TreeMap<Integer, Integer> freq = new TreeMap<>();
        int balance = (a[0] % 2 == 0 ? 1 : 0) - (a[0] % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0);

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            if (balance == 0) {
                int cost = Math.abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]);
                freq.put(cost, freq.getOrDefault(cost, 0) + 1);
            }
            if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
                balance++;
            } else {
                balance--;
            }
        }

        long sum = 0;
        int count = 0;

        for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : freq.entrySet()) {
            int cost = entry.getKey();
            int f = entry.getValue();

            if (cost == 0) {
                count += f;
                continue;
            }

            long can = (b - sum) / cost;
            if (can >= f) {
                count += f;
                sum += (long) cost * f;
            } else {
                count += (int) can;
                break;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(count);
    }
}
